title: A launched agent runs the Lab's v2 on its own session and receives its brief

steps.brief: Add a health check to the service
steps.why: fleet-switchboard launch: a session, a tab opened by argv, the pane verified, only then the brief

expect.name: fleet-metadata
expect.why: session.get returns the cast's metadata.fleet: name, role, reports_to, issue

expect.name: runs-v2
expect.why: herdr names the agent opencode on that session, and the pane's process is the configured v2

expect.name: brief-as-fleet-prompt
expect.text: Add a health check to the service
expect.why: The brief is a prompt marked as the fleet's, so it is not taken for yours

expect.name: nothing-typed
expect.why: The pane has no shell: v2 was started by argv, so there was nothing to type into
